newsitem.title: USA: Rykoff-Sexton says EPS on track.
newsitem.headline: Rykoff-Sexton says EPS on track.

text.p: Rykoff-Sexton Inc said Wednesday its results for the fiscal year to date are in line with its previous forecast of full-year earnings of $0.50 to $0.60 per share.

The company today reported third quarter earnings of $4.0 million, or $0.14 per share. For the nine months, its earnings totalled nearly $10 million, or $0.35 a share. The company's fiscal year ends June 28.
There are no directly comparable prior-year results because of the company's merger with US Foodservice on May 17, 1996, and the change in its fiscal year, Rykoff-Sexton said.
Rykoff-Sexton provides food and related non-food items to restaurants and other facilities.
